vb_textbox.text: When selecting the gnomes, keep picking the highest point scoring combination eg the red and purple gnomes together, if they both score +5 each as a combination, keep picking them until the points start to drop off, the same can be said for the green and brown gnome combination. Once you notice that the points are dropping to 0,1, 2 or 3 - switch to the alternative colour and stay on it within that particular combination of colours, until again you notice the points dropping, switch and stick to that same coloured gnome and repeat the process. After the first 10-20 rounds you should notice a correlation. Good Luck!
